index.html.title: 2D Game Template
index.html.summary: 2D Game Template A 2D game template for Visual Studio built for Mohawk College's GAME 10003 Game Development Foundations course with the goal to a beginner-friendly 2D game programming environment. API Reference How do you code using the library? View the MohawkGame2D API Reference. The content provided in MyCanvas discusses some of this code in more detail.
